description: This file defines the Link2 class, which represents a relationship from a single bean's perspective within the SuiteCRM (a fork of SugarCRM) framework. It handles relationship loading, querying, adding, removing, and managing related beans and relationship metadata, tying into the internal relationship and bean management systems.

classes.name: Link2
classes.description: Represents a relationship from a single bean's perspective, providing methods to load, query, add, remove, and manage related beans and relationship metadata within SuiteCRM's framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Link2 object by determining relationship definitions, loading the relationship object, and setting up linking metadata based on vardefs and focus bean.

methods.name: loadedSuccesfully
methods.description: Returns false if no relationship was found or loaded successfully for this link.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads related relationship data according to provided parameters and sets internal state.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a relationship query using the associated SugarRelationship object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs of related records, loading the relationship if not already loaded.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module on the other side of this relationship.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleLinkName
methods.description: Returns the name of the link field used on the related module's side of the relationship.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns 'many' or 'one' depending on the relationship type.

methods.name: getFocus
methods.description: Returns the focus SugarBean instance associated with this link.

methods.name: getRelatedFields
methods.description: Returns related fields from the relationship definition.

methods.name: getRelatedField
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific related field from the relationship definition.

methods.name: getRelationshipObject
methods.description: Returns the SugarRelationship object associated with this link.

methods.name: getSide
methods.description: Determines whether this link is on the left or right side of the relationship.

methods.name: isParentRelationship
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is a parent-type relationship.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Returns a join statement for this relationship, optionally as an array.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns a query string or array to retrieve IDs of related records.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Returns a subpanel-specific query, for use in displaying related records.

methods.name: getBeans
methods.description: Returns related SugarBean objects, loading them if necessary, with optional query parameters.

methods.name: beansAreLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the beans related to this link are already loaded.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a relationship link between the focus bean and specified related beans.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a relationship link between the focus bean and specified related beans.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the relationship for a given parent and related record ID.

methods.name: getRelatedBean
methods.description: Retrieves a related SugarBean by ID from the relevant module.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic getter to access relationship type, beans, rows, or internal relationship object.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic setter for properties like 'beans'.

methods.name: addBean
methods.description: Adds a SugarBean to the temporary or loaded beans list for this relationship.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Removes a specific SugarBean from this relationship's loaded beans.
